#######################################################################################
# Six-gluon MHV amplitude, near-collinear OPE at order T^2 F^{+-2}, N^3LL terms (Log[T]^(L-4)) for L = 7, 8, 9,
# as EXACT RATIONAL series in y = S^2 through y^40 (all lny powers, zeta monomials explicit).
# Conventions as in hexagon_T2F2_OPE_LL_NLL.txt: u = F/D, v = F S^2/((1+T^2) D), w = T^2/(1+T^2), D = F+FS^2+ST+F^2ST+FT^2,
#   y = S^2, lny = Log[y], g^2 = lambda/(16 pi^2), z_n = zeta(n) (even zetas kept as z2, z4, ...; products of even zetas
#   are reduced to a single even zeta: z2^2 = (5/2) z4 etc.; z_{odd} products kept as monomials).
# At T^2 F^{+-2} the framed Wilson loop is W|_{T^2 F^{+-2}} = (F^2 + 1/F^2) [ W_[2] + W_[1,1] ]  (BSV III eq. (53):
#   2cos(2phi)(W_{DF} + W_{FF})); these are the ONLY helicity-2 twist-2 states.  At L loops W_[1,1] = O(g^8) contributes to
#   Log[T]^k with k <= L-4 only; its Log[T]^(L-4) term is EXACTLY Born x [lnT (E1(u)+E1(v))]^(L-4)/(L-4)! with the Born
#   integrand of BSV III eq. (54) and one-loop gluon energies.  W_[2] at Log[T]^(L-4) is the N^3LL term of the
#   finite-coupling bound-state integral (mu_2 at NNLO, E_2 at four loops, p_2 at three loops).
# Exactly: E|_{T^2 F^{+-2}} = E|_{T^0} (W_[2] + W_[1,1]),  E|_{T^0} = rho^-1 exp[(Gcusp/4)(-2 Log[T]^2 - lny^2/2 - 2 z2)].
# Blocks:
#   W2T2ser[L,L-4]  : W_[2]^(L)   at Log[T]^(L-4), exact series through y^40
#   WFFT2ser[L,L-4] : W_[1,1]^(L) at Log[T]^(L-4), exact series through y^40
#   WT2F2ser[L,L-4] : their sum.   (Also, for reference, the k = L-3 (NNLL) blocks of W_[2], to which W_[1,1] does not contribute.)
# Validation: (i) W_[2]^(4)+W_[1,1]^(4) at Log[T]^0, y^1 reproduces BSV III Table 1 (B, g^8 tau^0) exactly;
#   (ii) the (L,k) = (4,0) and (5,1), (6,2) W_[1,1] blocks agree between the exact engine and an independent modular engine;
#   (iii) W_[2] at k >= L-3 reproduces 1308.2276 at 3 loops (all k) and the LL/NLL closed forms of hexagon_T2F2_OPE_LL_NLL.txt.
#######################################################################################
